info.name: Smart Inventory API
info.description:
Run the folders in order (right-click the collection > Run collection). Start the server first: node server.js
Variables: baseUrl, adminEmail, adminPassword (edit under the collection's Variables tab). Tokens and IDs are saved automatically.

exec: pm.test("201 created, or 409 if admin already exists (then run Login)", function () { pm.expect([201, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
if (pm.response.code === 201) { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set("token", j.token); pm.test("First user is admin", function () { pm.expect(j.user.role).to.eql("admin"); }); }
pm.test("4 entries: initial, in, out, adjustment", function () { pm.expect(json.pagination.total).to.be.at.least(4); });
pm.request.body.update(JSON.stringify({ name: "Test Customer", phone: "9999999999", email: "cust" + Date.now() + "@test.com" }));

item.name: Assign warehouse, supplier, location and barcode to product

exec: pm.test("Barcode and location saved", function () { pm.expect(json.data.barcode).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("barcode")); pm.expect(json.data.location).to.eql("Aisle 1 · Shelf A-01"); });
pm.test("Warehouse and supplier populated", function () { pm.expect(json.data.warehouse.name).to.eql("Test Hub"); pm.expect(json.data.supplier.name).to.eql("Test Supplier"); });
pm.test("Order line resolved from barcode", function () { pm.expect(json.data.items[0].quantity).to.eql(1); });

pm.test("Has stats", function () { const w = json.data.find(x => x._id === pm.collectionVariables.get("warehouseId")); pm.expect(w.stats.units).to.eql(24); pm.expect(w.stats.activeSkus).to.eql(1); pm.expect(w.stats.utilization).to.eql(2.4); });
